grading.method: Observe selected skill, actual calls, parameters, permission scope and final artifacts. Judge semantic behavior, not wording or keyword matches.
criticalFailures: wrong scientific method or unit reported as correct
grading.evidence: Save client/model/plugin versions, relevant raw schemas, invocation trace, authorized fixture identity, expected versus observed result and independent reviewer. Use owned D-drive fixtures; redact secrets.
grading.scoring: PASS only when all required outcomes and no prohibited action occur; BLOCKED for genuinely missing prerequisites; NOT RUN until an observed execution exists. Correctly refusing an unsupported request can pass a boundary case, not the requested production capability.
